blind.description: A wall-mounted wooden blacksmith tool rack featuring a top horizontal rail and vertical wooden backboard. Hanging on the rack from left to right are three mallets/hammers with light wood handles and dark metal square heads, followed by three pairs of dark wrought-iron blacksmith tongs. The back shows plain vertical wood planking. All geometry is solid, continuous, and clean with stylized hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangular dark brown beam with slightly wider decorative end caps, showing small tool tops protruding along the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the figure (approx. 2 ft / 0.6 m tall) and about half the figure's height in width (approx. 3 ft / 0.9 m wide).
